decoder: Pinned greedy generateChat; one draft and at most one separate-context audit, no retries or seed search
architecture: Immutable edition/passage/hash/sentence offset catalog; typed obligation, exact source-sentence references, subject, material time/condition and complete claim. Render only typed links. Independent-context same-model semantic audit of actual selected spans checks every claim and all obligations; not independent criticism or entailment proof. Fail closed on malformed, truncated, cancelled, missing, mismatched or withheld records.
evidence: Same task220 six oracle passages; new twelve frozen cases reuse the same real sources. No production retrieval claim. Sentence spans limited to first1200characters per passage with exact UTF16 offsets and full passage SHA256; no rewritten source content.
runtime: Reuse sealed task220 host library with 4096/512 host profile; Android limits/model.env unchanged
resource_limits: Require at least8GiB MemAvailable at launch; sampled RSS ceiling8GiB, timeout14400seconds; no concurrent emulator or other inference launched by this task
evaluation: All48old plus12new, real native draft and audit where structurally admissible; preserve every stage. Require >4/40 useful eligible old answers, zero unsupported eligible, eight old absent withheld. New cases reported separately. Builder source assessments never alter controller route.
historical_regressions: Actual task220 failures also bound into syntactically valid typed records and audited, so syntax rejection alone cannot claim repaired support. These are separate replay/audit tests, not new generation successes.
